title: Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent can retain successful trajectories without learning which part of an experience should repair a new discrepancy. We formulate passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes a violated contract, extracts a local goal, proposes an effect-matched skill, tests a small patch, and retains evidence after full-task verification. We instantiate this loop as a deterministic symbolic controller and analyze its finite repair-query complexity under explicit identifiability and noninterference assumptions. Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. translated_title: 模仿是进化的关键：面向自适应智能体的局部化修复与经验证的技能习得
translated_abstract: 智能体可以保留成功的轨迹，却不了解经验中的哪个部分应当用来修复新的差异。我们将被动模仿形式化为一种架构循环：定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配的技能、测试一个小补丁，并在完成全任务验证后保留证据。我们将该循环实例化为一个确定性符号控制器，并在明确的可识别性与无干扰假设下分析其有限的修复查询复杂度。在十个模拟工具世界中，被动模仿（PI）在允许三次小型试验的条件下解决了全部600个冷启动保留组合任务，而整轨迹对照组仅为6.17%；同时，一个表达能力相当的组合修复对照组与PI表现相当。在一个未见过的工具修订上，PI达到70.0%的成功率，不使用小型试验时为24.0%，使用自我试验枚举时为79.0%；随后，一个探索性的24任务适应流进一步提高了……
tldr: 论文将被动模仿形式化为一种架构循环——定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配的技能、测试小补丁并在全任务验证后保留证据——使智能体在600个组合任务上取得100%成功率（整轨迹基线仅6.17%），并在未见过的工具修订上达到70%的成功率。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes violated contracts, extracts local goals, proposes effect-matched skills, and retains verified evidence, enabling agents to solve 100% of 600 compositional tasks versus 6.17% for a whole-trajectory baseline and achieve 70% success on unseen tool revisions.
